args.message: Customer counts by total revenue band (sum of order amounts, all orders): 61 customers under 1,000; 68 from 1,000 to under 2,000; 49 from 2,000 to under 3,000; and 23 at 3,000 or more, for 201 customers in total. Orders with no customer ID (515.47 in total) are left out, so they don't count as an extra customer in the lowest band.
